inclusions.text: Base package: all driving and logistics
inclusions.source: The tour is offered in three tiers, so you only pay for what you want: a Base package (private vehicle, guide, water, and all driving and logistics); Base + Entrance Fees (the same, plus every site entry on the route); and Base + Entrance Fees & Lunch (entrance fees plus a midday meal at a local restaurant).

exclusions.text: Entrance fees kept separate from the Base package
exclusions.source: Egyptian entrance fees are revised often, so keeping them separate keeps the base fare honest.

exclusions.text: Tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62) requires a separate ticket
exclusions.source: The standard entry covers three tombs from a rotating selection; the tomb of Tutankhamun (KV62) requires a separate ticket, noted in the inclusions below.
